description: This file defines an immutable data class 'AdvancedQueryData' used for representing datatable query configurations, including column filters and result columns within the Apache Fineract project.

classes.name: AdvancedQueryData
classes.description: Immutable data object representing datatable data, including column filters and result columns for advanced queries.

methods.name: getNonNullFilters
methods.description: Returns the list of column filters, ensuring a non-null list.

methods.name: hasFilter
methods.description: Checks if there are any column filters applied.

methods.name: getNonNullResultColumns
methods.description: Returns the list of result columns, ensuring a non-null list.

methods.name: hasResultColumn
methods.description: Checks if there are any result columns specified.
